items.title: Kenny Barron — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Yeah. She’s in New York. She did this fantastic arrangement of one of my songs, Voyage, that was – I didn’t know what it was until she started – finally she played the melody. “Oh wow.” She started out as a classical pianist, and somehow she became fascinated with jazz. So she’s able to do both things. On one of her more recent albums, she did a whole thing of this Spanish – the classical composer, Ibanez?
